g.text: 1. Function: Murata Type 2EL (NXP IW612): Wi-Fi 6 on SDIO 3.0, Bluetooth 5.4 on UART1 with

g.desc: 1. Function: Murata Type 2EL (NXP IW612): Wi-Fi 6 on SDIO 3.0, Bluetooth 5.4 on UART1 with

g.text: flow control; nxpwifi and btnxpuart (DKMS until Linux 7.3). 802.15.4 SPI not wired (T1-077).

g.desc: flow control; nxpwifi and btnxpuart (DKMS until Linux 7.3). 802.15.4 SPI not wired (T1-077).

g.text: 2. Absent state: rails off (blk.radio-power), wake lines pulled to no wake by the SoC.

g.desc: 2. Absent state: rails off (blk.radio-power), wake lines pulled to no wake by the SoC.

g.text: 3. CONFIG_HOST[1:0] = 11 (SDIO, UART, SPI hosts; Figure 5 note 2). RF_CNTL, GPIO, PCM, WCI-2,

g.desc: 3. CONFIG_HOST[1:0] = 11 (SDIO, UART, SPI hosts; Figure 5 note 2). RF_CNTL, GPIO, PCM, WCI-2,

g.text: reset indicators and reserved pins open (E2B-09-1413 §3.3); module land from Murata's DXF,
